card.name: Time unit ending a per-period rate
card.fires_on: The time word that closes a rate phrase after 'per' or 'each', such as year, day, week or night. It also fires on 'featured' after 'each day ... is'.

modes.label: Per-period rates
modes.description: A time unit completes a phrase like 'per year' or 'per day' after an amount.
modes.example: Use no more than 50 mL per<< week>>. ( 2 ) • Do not

modes.label: Each/every period
modes.description: A time noun follows 'each' or 'every' to say how often something happens.
modes.example: catch” genital herpes each<< year>> and the number of Type 1 infections

modes.label: Daily recurrence verb
modes.description: A verb after 'each day' describing something that recurs daily.
modes.example: Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is<< featured>>, along with a brief explanation written by

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning daily, weekly, yearly and annual, so the rate is not stated a second time.
card.plain: It marks the end of a 'per day' or 'each year' phrase, where the frequency is already given.
